item.title: Overview
item.description: Symphony operates within an orchestration layer, strategically positioned atop preexisting tools and services. To establish uniformity amidst the diverse edge environment, Symphony relies on a set of fundamental high-level abstractions. These encompass state-seeking, graph, workflow, and orchestration models. These foundational abstractions empower Symphony to deliver robust functionalities across various technologies and platforms while maintaining a concise object model. Abstractions Information graph: How Symphony organizes, accesses, and synchronizes enterprise information. Orchestration model: How Symphony defines the components that make up a scenario.
